method_note: Each point is the longitude/latitude of the single feature returned by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) address search (msearch.gsi.go.jp/address-search/AddressSearch, keyless GET) for the street address that Equinix gives on its own IBX page (Internet Archive raw copies of 3 October 2026; www.equinix.com answers robots.txt with HTTP 403, so the live pages were not requested), written in Japanese form (for example 東京都江東区有明1-2-41). Each response holds exactly one feature resolved to the house number (号). Coordinates are used unchanged (JGD2011 geographic, treated as WGS84-equivalent at this precision; no transformation or rounding). GSI's reverse geocoder was queried at each point for the municipality and chome. For identity review only, GSI standard-map tiles (cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/std, z18, 0.485 m per pixel at this latitude) were captured and the point's pixel position and the distance to the nearest drawn building outline were measured with Python (Pillow 11.0.0); geodesic distances use pyproj 3.7.1 (WGS84). No commercial map, map embed or map-widget parameter, short link, PeeringDB record or OpenStreetMap service was used; no token or key was used. GSI content is reused under GSI's content terms with attribution (the terms page on www.gsi.go.jp could not be captured in this pass because its robots.txt was unreachable, so the licence label follows the Atlas's existing GSI evidence rows).
site_versus_campus_review: Equinix gives TY6 and TY7 the same address (2-2-43 Higashi-Shinagawa) and the other Tokyo pages describe both as 'located at 2-2-43, Higashi-shinagawa', so they form one campus site with one project (as the Atlas did for Sydney SY1/SY2 at 639 Gardeners Road). TY8 (2-1-7 Higashi-Shinagawa, Harbor Premium II) has its own address in a different block (1-ban); its GSI point is 50.2 m from the TY6/TY7 point but on the opposite side of the same street, at a different building, so it is its own site. Equinix's Tokyo listing groups 'our TY6/TY7/TY8 data centers' only as neighbours. TY2 (3-8-21 Higashi-Shinagawa) is 556-605 m south of them. TY3 (1-9-20 Edagawa) and TY5 (1-10-19 Edagawa) are 198.3 m apart in different blocks (9-ban and 10-ban) and different buildings, so each is its own site. TY11 (1-2-41 Ariake) is more than 2 km from every other point. As a consistency check, the GSI block-level point for TY15's address (港南三丁目6番; held, not used as a locator) is 1,040.9 m from the TY6/TY7 point and 1,646.3 m from the TY2 point, matching Equinix's statement that TY15 is 'about 1km from our TY6/TY7/TY8 data centers' with TY2 'just 1.5km away'.
